crossRefs.note: If one attacks him with the sword, it can’t prevail; nor the spear, the dart, nor the pointed shaft.

translations.web: Can you fill his skin with barbed irons, or his head with fish spears?
translations.bsb: Can you fill his hide with harpoons or his head with fishing spears?
translations.kjv: Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons? or his head with fish spears?
translations.asv: Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons, Or his head with fish-spears?
